title: Project Kanban Manager
summary: Own the sealed project's main task kanban and every desk's mini headless board: show/add/move cards, sync desk minis into the main board, pull assigned cards onto desks. Owns the project ticket lifecycle (accept/rework/close/digest) for agent request/claim/submit work.
cronHints: No schedule declared in the playbook — this desk is wake-on-demand only.
